# Review — cid-tiradas-69-74 (tiradas 69–74, lines 1156–1220)

Adversarial review against the pinned packet, Pidal's rubrics and footnotes on the scan (PDF pp. 207–212 read at
150 dpi, with a crop at 500 dpi of v. 1189 to settle rritad), conventions.md, the pilot (01-04) and the published
parts (especially 32-34, 44-48 and 64-68), the shared glossary and known-forms.json. All edits made by script
(json load/dump, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1). No `t` changed: the 65 `t` lines concatenated equal the 65
established verses in print order (1195–1199, 1206, 1207, 1200–1205, 1208–1220) exactly, checked by script before
and after the edits; one `l` line per `t` line in all 28 units; no unit crosses a tirada break.

Checked and found sound (no change):
- Rubrics against the scan, all six right: 69 Correrías del Cid al sur de Valencia (p. 207); 70 El Cid en Peña
  Cadiella; 71 Conquista de toda la región de Valencia (p. 208); 72 El Cid asedia a Valencia.—Pregona a los
  cristianos la guerra (p. 209); 73 Repítese el pregón. (Serie gemela.); 74 Gentes que acuden al pregón.—Cerco y
  entrada de Valencia (p. 210). Assonances re-derived: 69 á-a (Xátiva proparoxytone counts); 70 é-a; 71 á-o; 72 á
  with padre, fanbre, menssajes; 73 é-a; 74 á with partes, fazen, caen, alcáç[er]. Right in all six first notes.
- Footnotes against the scan, wording right: 1154 (nuevas 'renombre, fama', comp. 1556, 1206, 2084), 1159 (davan
  'enviaban, despachaban', 1405, comp. 652), 1160 (Gujera/Cullera; castle at the mouth of the Júcar; 30 km from
  Játiva, 55 from Denia), 1161 (Denia la casa 'la población de Denia', v. 1232), 1163 (Pennacatel, Peñacadell,
  Benicadell; Albaida/Concentaina — Pidal's spelling; rebuilt 1092; Alcoy y Alicante), 1169 (duró 'tardó, empleó,
  gastó', v. 2251), 1176 (consejo 'amparo, socorro'), 1182 (Montes Claros = Atlas; Almohads 1120; 1145), 1183
  ('no les dijo manera de salir de su apuro, ni les vino a ayudar'), 1189 (pregón algo semejante, p. 95–96), 1194
  (now right), 1204 (sin art 'sin engaño', 'perfectamente', comp. 690; 'no había defecto'), 1208 ('Púsola en plazo
  …'; Arabic history, fifteen days' truce, Zaragoza and Murcia), 1209 (twenty months; second part of the siege;
  vv. 1170 ss.). No other footnotes on these pages (1222 ff. on p. 212 belong to the next part). The "Pidal gives no
  note" claims (andon, ma'les, ques, rritad, Mon Real, reordering, pla[zd]o) are right.
- Print order against the margin of pp. 210–211: 1199, 1206, 1207 at the foot of p. 210; 1200 heads p. 207 of the
  book; 1205, then 1208. The note to 1206 says so and that Pidal gives no reason on the page (his motive hedged
  "presumably").
- Italics seen on the image and reported: andon, co[n]ssejo, co[n]sejo, ve[e]r, lo[s], [a] trasnocha[r], s[o]s,
  [Campeador leal], quiere[n], va[n], vi[d]o, pla[zd]o, [e]s, f[o]ron, alcáç[er]. ma'les printed with the apostrophe;
  rritad at 500 dpi plain (a speck above the t, no mark).
- Cross-references checked in the published parts: priso v. 1095, vi[d]íe v. 1096, es logar v. 1146, qué se far
  v. 1155, f[o]sse v. 61, Vedada / Burgos la casa v. 62 — all where the notes put them.
- Grammar labels checked and right: -ra pluperfect (ayudara, fiziera), personal a + resumptive los/la (1162, 1170,
  1179), escarmentados los han (participle agreeing), se before the infinitive (se ajuntar, la dar), tajávales /
  fazíales (dative of the person harmed), tollió, nos = no se (1177), aver a + inf. (ovieron a enbiar, oviérongela a
  dar), gela, Sópolo, amaneció a + person, mandar + inf., viniesse (subjunctive as command in reported speech),
  a = ha (a sabor, ganada se la a), ir + bare inf. (ir … çercar), Tornávas, Andidieron, compeçós de pagar
  (pagarse 'be pleased'), creçiendo va, viédales, yaz (present amid preterites), podrie/podrié, quantos que allí ha
  (impersonal), sedié (imperfect of seer), double negatives.
- `l` ↔ `i` unit by unit: no remembered English found. House usage kept: "my Çid", Çid in `i` (as 64-68), Vivar,
  "be sure of it" / "know-ye" for sabet, Campeador 'the Battler' (pilot), Minaya not present. Brackets in `l` for
  restored words ([they-go], [to], [Campeador loyal], [th]at) follow parts 05-09 to 49-55.

Findings refused:
- 1211 "Historically Valencia surrendered to the Cid in 1094": outside Pidal's notes, but certain and plainly
  stated as history, not as his. Left.
- 1216 la quinta "the leader's customary share of the booty": general and certain (and already the shared
  glossary's sense). Left.
- 1156 [andon] "seems to be a form of andar": hedged, and the note says it breaks the assonance. Left.
- 1165 ma'les = mal les: Pidal's apostrophe, no note; the hedge stands (and the shared glossary already gives
  ma'les = mal les). Left.
- 1159 `i` "He sent out his raiders" for davan (3rd pl.): sus is 'his'; the Çid is the agent through his men. Left.
- 1161 "(compare v. 1232; casa as in Burgos la casa, v. 62)": the v. 62 comparison is ours but reads as such in the
  parenthesis. Left.
- 1203 sobrellas "the city and its people, loosely": hedged. Left.

Counts: error 4 · weak 12 · style 9 (25 changes)

Checked: gloss keys (77, excluding __broaden__) equal the novel-forms.json keys exactly. Every __broaden__ value
(13: davan, duró, echar, fazen, les, mingua, nos, ovieron, que, ques, quien, recabdo, çerca) begins with the
known-forms.json entry verbatim + " · also" (checked by script). All tokens of the 65 lines (brackets stripped,
lowercased, apostrophe splitting) are covered by known + gloss. Other entries checked and right: alent, andon
(hedged), ayudara, fiziera, fazien, trasnochadas, gujera, xátiva, ayusso, denia, quebranta, ganaron, peña, cadiella,
exidas, entradas, dolor, ganando, durmiendo, tranochando, villas, escarmentados, fueras, tajávales, huertas,
fazíales, destos, sabent, viníe, da, conssejo, fijo, consolar, señores, fanbre, marruecos, montes, claros, avíe,
sópolo, amaneció, navarra, pregón, perder, viniesse, speraré, tornávas, ganada, detardar, creçiendo, sobrellas
(hedged), avía, hart (Pidal cited), viédales, nueve, meses, complidos, yaz, dezeno, gozos, çibdad, podrie, cabdal.
Known entries covering this part's uses (no broaden needed): le (leísmo 'him' covers tres días le speraré), a (ha
before participle, personal a, a sabor), han (perfect agreeing), ha (impersonal, 'has'), sabet, va (ir + gerund /
inf.), vienen, van, vino, viniessen, consejo ('help, remedy'), nuevas ('renown'), so/sos ('their'), pagar
(pagarse), grado (de grado), casa, cabo, es (es logar), i, aver (noun), foron, vos, quantos.

Findings refused:
- __broaden__ les 'from them' (dative of removal): the known 'to them' would serve, but tollió and viédales make
  the sense worth naming. Kept.
- __broaden__ ovieron, quien: each a use the known entry lacks (aver a + inf.; 'whoever', interrogative). Kept.
- marruecos "i.e. the Almoravid ruler": outside Pidal's note to 1182, but certain history and consistent with his
  note to 1222. Left.
- si 'in case' (si les viniessen huviar, Pidal 'por si'): the known 'if' is close enough. Left.
- juntadas: the known example (ganançias) is pinned to another part, but the meaning fits. Left.

## Readings left uncertain

- v. 1156 [andon]: Pidal's supplied word, no note; taken as a form of andar 'they go'; breaks the á-a assonance.
- v. 1165 ma'les: taken as mal les; no note.
- v. 1174 ques far: taken as qué se far (cf. v. 1155); no note.
- v. 1189 rritad: 'wealth', a noun on rico; no gloss in Pidal.
- v. 1186 Mon Real: presumably the Monreal del Campo of v. 862.
- v. 1203 sobrellas: feminine plural antecedent unclear.
- v. 1204 hart: Pidal's own 'parece significar' 'no había defecto'.
- v. 1207 nos le van: the no taken as redundant after the comparison.
- v. 1208 pla[zd]o: the manuscript reading behind Pidal's italic zd is not shown.
- Pidal gives no reason on the page for printing 1206–1207 after 1199.

no unit crosses a tirada. gloss.json: 77 keys = novel-forms.json, 13 broadens all prefix-exact.
